items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Per operator go-ahead (2026-10-23): the 80% coverage thresholds are now enforced (flattened out of the Jest-style 'global' key, which vitest read as a glob matching nothing). The Node minimum is stated in .nvmrc (22) and package.json engines (>=22.12), and the README names both.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No dependency, secret or CI workflow changed; the lockfile diff is only the engines field.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Red/green proof: with the old nested key at 99%, vitest --coverage exited 0 (gate ignored). With the flat key at 99% it exits 1 ('branches 87.66% does not meet global threshold 99%'). At the real 80% it exits 0. Current coverage: 92.2% statements, 87.7% branches, 89.7% functions, 92.9% lines.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Matches the vitest documented thresholds shape.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: .nvmrc is also read by Netlify's build image, so the Netlify fallback build now uses Node 22, the same as CI.
